Auto-learned at Void Refining. Hold cast key for 5 seconds (drains Qi) to enter Void Escape:
• Fully invisible to all players and NPCs
• Freely fly and pass through walls and blocks
• Invincible, cannot die, cannot cast anything
• Cannot be cast during heavenly tribulation; any lingering Void Escape is forcibly broken
• Bonus 10 'Spatial Stability' — each hit subtracts 1; reaches 0 forces reappear
• Drains Qi continuously; press cast key again to manually reappear
spell.friday_cultivation.void_step.desc:
Auto-learned at Void Refining. Three movement techniques:
• 3-block jump: on ground, double-tap Space → leap 3 blocks high (15 Qi)
• Slow-fall: automatic when you are ≥ 3.5 blocks above ground (free)
• Dash: while in slow-fall, double-tap any of W/S/A/D/Shift/Space → dash in that direction (60 Qi)
spell.friday_cultivation.spirit_vision.d: See floating Qi particles. Disable to render them invisible (mortal-like).
spell.friday_cultivation.yin_yang_eye.de: Mid-grade passive spell. While enabled, soul-state players and NPCs appear as translucent spirits. Learned and enabled by default on soul death, but can be disabled manually; disabled automatically when returning alive, then can be enabled manually.
spell.friday_cultivation.ghost_flight.de: Low-grade element-less rule passive. Learned and enabled by default while in soul state, but can be disabled manually. It grants souls Qi Flight-style free flight and controls without consuming Qi, and is removed automatically when the player leaves soul state.
spell.friday_cultivation.fireball.desc: Conjure a Qi-charged fireball that explodes on impact and ignites surroundings.
Condenses Qi into a colossal fireball. The longer it is charged, the larger the fireball becomes, increasing explosion damage, terrain destruction radius, and fireball rain scale. The blast ignites and demolishes a wide area. HOLD the cast key to charge (drains Qi continuously); release to launch. A quick tap fires a single block-sized version.
spell.friday_cultivation.sky_splitting_s: Immortal-tier Metal sword art. Tap spends 1000 Qi to launch a narrow aura with 1000 base damage and block destruction along its path. Hold, then release to launch a colossal aura: base damage = 2000 × charge multiplier, then multiplied by weapon spell damage and your Spell Power attribute. At 1000% charge or higher, hits also inflict system-level HP loss equal to 10% of that damage.
spell.friday_cultivation.sword_aura.desc: Supreme passive sword art. While holding a sword, left-clicks that miss living entities consume 50 qi to launch a sword aura. Style and effects shift with your dominant absorbed qi element: None=100 dmg, Ice=freeze+slow+blind, Metal=200 dmg, Wood=poison 10s, Water=drowning 10s, Fire=burn+ignite blocks, Earth=weakness 10s.
spell.friday_cultivation.flying_sword.de: Mid-tier metal sword art. Requires a sword in main hand. Releases a single flying sword from your position (15 qi) toward your crosshair, dealing 20 direct damage to the entity it strikes (further amplified by Metal element bonus). No terrain destruction, no explosion sound. Single shot, no charging or volley; vanishes on hit or after 10 seconds.
spell.friday_cultivation.clear_mind.desc: Low-tier element-less active spell. Manually consumes 50 Qi to remove all harmful status effects (poison, slowness, weakness, etc.) and extinguish ongoing fire. Beneficial effects (regen, strength, etc.) are preserved.
spell.friday_cultivation.clear_mind_inca: Supreme-tier element-less passive spell. Once enabled, checks every second for harmful status effects, automatically consuming 100 Qi to remove each one (200 for two, 300 for three, and so on). If Qi is insufficient to remove a given effect, that effect is preserved until the next attempt.
spell.friday_cultivation.immortal_incant: Legacy compatibility entry: Untainted Immortal Incantation is now an immortal-tier element-less technique. Old saves migrate it automatically.
spell.friday_cultivation.star_fall.desc: Channel the power of falling stars. Tap = single small meteor strikes your crosshair. Hold = continuous meteor rain. Hold for 5 seconds = the rain ceases and a colossal meteor descends slowly above your crosshair, impacting with shockwave and mushroom cloud.
spell.friday_cultivation.sword_convergen: Requires a sword in main hand. Condensed Qi forms flying swords that launch at your crosshair, exploding on impact. HOLD to spawn continuous swords (frequency/range grows with charge); swords during charging are immortal (re-target on each hit). Release — next impact destroys them. Quick tap = single sword.
spell.friday_cultivation.ice_lance.desc: Hurl an icy lance that damages and slows the target.
Call down a thunderbolt at where you are looking.
spell.friday_cultivation.palm_thunder.de: Supreme lightning active spell. Tap to form and instantly fire a white-violet thunder orb that bursts on impact without breaking blocks. Hold to condense a palm thunder seed that grows to full size; once fully formed it stays in your hand and drains 50 Qi/sec. While held, left-click a block, entity, or player to detonate at the target. Press Palm Thunder again to disperse it. Targets caught in the burst are thunder-bound for 3 seconds, lose flight, and take damage over time.
